nodes.label: Validation Path Breakdown
nodes.rationale: Schema validation dominates at 60-70% of total time, with XML parsing and element validation each taking 15-20%, indicating the validation logic is the primary bottleneck

nodes.label: Early Validation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Invalid documents are detected early (~25 μs) to minimize wasted compute, achieving 38K+ ips for malformed XML and missing attributes with low memory usage (~57-76 KB)

nodes.label: Linear Scaling Characteristic
nodes.rationale: Memory and processing time scale linearly with document complexity, from ~400 KB for simple ads to ~1.1 MB for multi-ad documents, enabling predictable capacity planning
